name: Spotted-belly Buprestid Beetle
desc: Spotted-belly Buprestid Beetle (Buprestis maculativentris): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Buprestis maculativentris, the ventrally spotted buprestid, is a species of metallic wood-boring beetle in the family Buprestidae. It is found in North America.
